# RepositoryIsNotDefinedException

<link-summary>A repository the script expected to be available is not.</link-summary>

<web-summary>RepositoryIsNotDefinedException — A repository the script expected to be available is not. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>exception</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
class RepositoryIsNotDefinedException extends RuntimeException
```

A repository the script expected to be available is not.

Thrown by [`requireRepository`](requireRepository.md).

Every class in this hierarchy takes an optional message, another exception whose message it reuses, or nothing at all. `isException` recognises all of them; a plain `Error` is not one.

## Examples

### Throwing and catching

```javascript
throw new RepositoryIsNotDefinedException("something specific about this call");

try {
  doWork();
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof RepositoryIsNotDefinedException) {
    // handled
  }
}
```
